name: Naughty Thoughts
overview: Scripture reveals that the heart is the wellspring of both life and sin, as evil thoughts and lustful desires originate there (Matthew 15:19; Proverbs 4:23). Jesus warns that even looking with lust is equivalent to committing adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28), highlighting the seriousness of inward purity. Believers are called to guard their hearts diligently and to renew their minds, putting off the corrupt nature shaped by deceitful lusts, so that their thoughts and attitudes align with the perfect will of God (Psalms 19:14; Romans 12:2; Ephesians 4:22).
